standard.summary: 训练时随机跳过部分 DiT block 以加速训练并提供正则化效果。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Randomly skips some DiT blocks during training, which speeds training up and acts as a regulariser.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 训练时随机跳过部分 DiT block 以加速训练并提供正则化效果。预期加速 5-10%。仅适用于 DiT 架构（Anima/Flux）。

advanced_en.principle: Randomly skips some DiT blocks during training to speed it up and provide regularization. Expected 5-10% speedup. DiT architectures only (Anima/Flux).
